decided: 2026-11-04, from rows/NXX.json 'presence' (census-scale real runs, 3 seeds) against the plan's per-model measure (PLANTED_PIPELINE_PLAN 'Implementation and fidelity'); decided after the gate results were known, which cannot change them (the gate saw no presence measure)

N01.basis: plan: P_sync set by the prime factors of N is a property of many starts across N; all 3 census runs ended fully synchronised (N = 200)

N02.basis: stationary pattern at the headline c = 0.01 in 3 of 3 seeds (Delta_phi 12.9-13.2, the module's tolerance); the plan's 'absent at c = 0.49' leg is a second setting, not run at census scale

N03.basis: cluster fraction S = 1 in every seed, cavities in 0% of frames (boiling_like 0 of 3); Q 5.3-5.5 against the paper's < 5.0 (over-clustering, as expected from the fidelity failure)

N04.basis: psi6 0.85 (high bond order) at the headline, but the plan's measure compares with the passive system at the same temperature, which the census run does not include (its knock-out is the non-interacting system)

N07.basis: fitted correlation exponent 3.73 +- 0.24 over r = 2-8, inside the plan's 3.5-4.5; the achiral comparison is part of the fidelity check, not the census run

N08.basis: one density peak (0.648) in every seed, no coexisting densities (two_phase 0 of 3)

N11.basis: anisotropy 0.18-0.23 (median 0.22), within 0.15 of the authors' 0.169 for the gap pattern at g = 3.14e-5 (deviation P2 criterion)

N12.basis: the measure is M^2 versus system size L; one census run has one L (64). M^2 = 0.51-0.54, close to the paper's fit extrapolated to L = 64 (0.539)

N13.basis: mean-opinion distribution over the run has 3 binned peaks, at -1, 0.3 and 1 (the plan's 'one near 0.3'); matches the exact stationary peaks

N14.basis: Gamma6 0.03 and n_L 0.39 against the paper's 0.79 and 0.97 after >= 2e6 cycles (census: 1,000 cycles)

N15.basis: system-spanning (95-98%), non-coarsening stream network in 3 of 3 seeds; correlation dimension 1.30-1.34 against the plan's 'near 1.5'; the paper's voids are larger than the census box

N17.basis: plan: lanes of band trains need boxes of side ~1,200; the 20 x 20 census box shows a band-like density mode (share 0.38-0.47) at polarization 0.63-0.69

N19.basis: 0 of 3 seeds with exactly one dense aggregate in travelling bands (2-3 aggregates in every frame pair); with 'at least one aggregate' 3 of 3 (reported only; slow merging in the 64 x 64 world)
